_comment: Copy to profile/facts.json (gitignored) and fill with YOUR truth. Every claim printed on a CV or letter must exist here or in an attested source the user supplied. The reviewer reads education and experience_policy; add your own sections freely.

experience_policy.rule: Never refuse a tech/IT job only because the JD asks for more years than the applicant has. HR wish-lists are noisy. Score tools and responsibilities actually held, mark stretch, still refuse wrong domains and hard eligibility bars (e.g. current-student-only when graduated).
